text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: —If only I could run like Brian-chan does.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
The world I will see must be yet another 
step above the one I see now.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Focusing all the energy coursing through 
my body straight into my legs—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I'll let it explode! I'll run so fast no 
one can catch up!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"And before I knew it, I even became a 
Triple Crown Umamusume before winning the 
Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe—"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, maybe that's asking for too 
much. My leg can't even run at full power 
yet."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Still.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
It hasn't been decided that I "can't do 
it" yet, after all.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
...To be frank, it would be more accurate 
to say that Laurel-san's legs 'remain 
unchanged.'

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Please make sure to continue your medical 
checkups and get as much rest as possible.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: Trainer, please support her too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Reality is harsh, isn't it! I wish we 
had made a bit more progress.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Still, since I can't put stress on my 
legs, what I can do is crystal clear. I'll 
keep doing my best, focusing mainly on 
observation!
choice_data_list:
The "running style you yearned for" that 
you found...

The "ideal running style" that you 
discovered, right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Come to think of it, did you see it 
too, Trainer? Brian-chan's press 
conference.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
It seems she's going down the Classic 
Triple Crown route after all. The Satsuki 
Sho, Japanese Derby, and Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
That is Brian-chan's goal. My goal, on the 
other hand—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...What should we do?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I do think she should continue running in 
races, but the lingering concern over her 
legs is worrisome.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It is true that pointing to a specific 
race as our definitive goal is still 
difficult under the current circumstances.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If her condition worsens, she might even 
have to withdraw from her target race. If 
that happens, even for her, it could take 
a toll on her motivation.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, if you consider what lies 
ahead...
choice_data_list: I'd like to enter a graded race, I think.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...! Graded race... meaning you'll be 
entering a GIII or higher?
choice_data_list:
And I really want you to finish in the top 
three!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Huh? That's weirdly specific.
choice_data_list:
If we're going to the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe, we need to build a track record.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Whoa...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
True, once you move up to the Classic 
class, you ought to be able to manage at 
least that much!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
After all, I'm the horse girl who's going 
to take 1st place in the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe in the future!
choice_data_list: That's right, let's do our best.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Trainer, I... It really is little by 
little, one step at a time, but—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Moving forward toward my dream...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(Trainer's eyes were sparkling again when 
we said goodbye...)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Fufu...♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(...! Wait, that voice just now... And the 
person over there is—)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yo, Brian! You doing some extra training 
now too?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I totally get it! Even after 
wrapping up training once, you just can't 
sit still, right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"I'm just like you, you know! It gets my 
heart pounding and all fired up."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"...You've decided to run the Classic 
Triple Crown route, haven't you?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Since there's only one shot at the race to 
decide the Junior Class champion, everyone 
was fired up, but...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...The Triple Crown chance that only comes 
once in a lifetime must fire them up even 
more.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I will be the one to hunt that passion 
down...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hah... ...Once we're both done with our 
respective paths, don't you go having a 
heart attack over how much I've grown, got 
it?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...A once-in-a-lifetime race.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: I also there—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Will I make it in time, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"...Am I going to end up never even 
getting to run in the Derby?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Nnnngh... Focus! I have to focus on my 
goal!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Place within the top 3 in a Gâ ¢ or above! 
At least once!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna do my best!
